title: Thumbnail editing joins the creative projects list
summary:
Community contributions brought an editable AI thumbnail project to the creative list and added a standalone email utility.

Mustafiz82 added Green Hope AI to the creative projects list. It generates AI thumbnails and lets people adjust text, placement, styles, and effects without starting over.

Jay-1409 added a separate Next.js utility with endpoints for custom and welcome emails, reusable message templates, and a service health check. It is not connected to existing Pollinations services.

highlights.title: Editable AI thumbnails
highlights.text: Green Hope AI joins the creative projects list. Generate a thumbnail, then adjust its text, placement, styles, and effects without starting over.
